notes.text: **Merged by the operator seat** — review: Reviewed against the card's Done when. All five met: blockers:'all' REST-fills every open card only where GraphQL blockedBy is missing; blockers:true is byte-for-byte the old todo/blocked behaviour; the board carries its own provenance (source/filled/scope) as a NON-ENUMERABLE property so every existing caller still sees a plain array, with blockersOf/blockersKnown answering unknown-vs-none; doctor names the one-REST-call-per-open-card cost; src/model.js untouched, as the Contract required. Verified myself: CI green (test + packed artifact), lint clean, 932 tests pass on the branch (up from 924). Eight new tests, including the two that matter most — 'a repo with GraphQL blockedBy makes no extra request for all' (pins the frugality claim by counting calls) and 'blockersKnown tells an empty list apart from a list nobody read' (pins the silently-wrong-answer case the card exists to prevent)., checks: green, method: squash

residual_risk: The provenance record lives on the array as a non-enumerable property, so it does not survive board.map/filter/slice - a caller that reshapes the board must read blockersOf/blockersKnown against the original array from fetchBoard.
blockers: 'all' costs one REST call per open card on a repo without GraphQL blockedBy; nothing rate-limits or batches it, doctor only names the cost.
No caller passes 'all' yet - hkb groom (a sibling card) is the first, so the path is covered by tests only until it lands.
docs/wiki was already stale board-wide before this change and was left alone; the groom feature page belongs to the later node in track #191.

results.summary: fetchBoard(ctx, { blockers: 'all' }) now REST-fills blockers for every OPEN card on a repo without GraphQL Issue.blockedBy; blockers: true is unchanged (todo/blocked only) and blockers: false still asks for nothing. A repo WITH the GraphQL field makes no extra request for any value - pinned by a test that counts every call. The array fetchBoard returns carries a non-enumerable provenance record { source: 'graphql'|'rest'|null, filled: boolean, scope: 'all'|'open'|'waiting'|'none' }, read through two new exports from src/tasks.js: blockersOf(board) returns the record (safe on a plain array, defaults to { source: null, filled: false, scope: 'none' }), and blockersKnown(board, task) returns whether that task's blockedBy is a real answer or was never looked up. blockersKnown is what the unknown_blockers finding must use: an empty blockedBy on a card outside the fill-in's scope means UNKNOWN, never no_blockers. The record is non-enumerable so JSON.stringify, Object.keys, spreads and for..of over the board are unchanged. src/doctor.js gains an exported checkGroomBlockers(ctx, { ok, warn }, { caps, board }) and GROOM_BLOCKERS_CHECK = 'groom blockers', called from the run right after the GraphQL capability lines: ok when blockedByGql is present ('hkb groom costs no extra request'), warn otherwise naming the cost as N REST calls, one per open card, using the shared board read for N. src/model.js and src/dispatch.js are untouched. PR https://github.com/emyann/harness-kanban-board/pull/230 (draft, base main).
